integration.purpose: Preserve archive extraction locking without hard links and exclude macOS AppleDouble metadata from object collection on ExFAT.
integration.scope: Only libsodium/build-aux/ltmain.sh archive extraction locking and extracted-object collection change. Cargo.toml, build.rs, Rust API/FFI bindings, cryptographic implementation, configure, target selection and independent compiler locking remain upstream-exact.
integration.original_hashes: files records every included source file original Git blob and mode before applying the one local patch.

delta: Replace ln "$progpath" "$lockfile" acquisition with atomic mkdir "$lockfile"; retain lock_old_archive_extraction, opt_dry_run, the wait message and retry interval.
On extraction failure, capture stat=$? before cleanup, remove the directory only when archive locking is enabled, and exit with the saved extraction status even if cleanup fails.
On normal completion, replace rm -f "$lockfile" with rmdir "$lockfile", retaining the existing archive-lock and dry-run guards.
Exclude ._* AppleDouble metadata sidecars when collecting extracted .o/.lo files so archive members remain real object files on non-native macOS filesystems.

source_closure.acquisition: Read exact Git trees and git archive objects from the existing Cargo checkout without modifying its worktree, index, object store or configuration. Each selected archive member was checked against SHA-1("blob " + decimal byte length + NUL + original bytes) before extraction.
preserved_build_inputs: Original crate manifest, build.rs, src/lib.rs and generated src/sodium_bindings.rs.
All six pinned MinGW/MSVC native Windows dependency libraries selected by build.rs; these are upstream dependency assets, not historical packaged engine binaries.
Pinned libsodium C/header sources, configure/Autotools inputs, all recursive Makefile inputs and build helpers, platform build scripts and generated Visual Studio projects.

Pinned libsodium/test remains inside this dependency because unchanged native build.rs invokes make check; cross builds retain make all. No upstream tests are copied into engine tests and no new tests are added.
Original OHOS configure/toolchain/link behavior and all other build.rs environment/target branches remain untouched.
source_closure.omissions: Only the optional files listed in omitted_files are excluded from the selected upstream crate/submodule. The surrounding sodiumoxide workspace/application is not vendored; Git administration and Cargo checkout markers are not source inputs.

licenses.notice: The original copyright, license and special distribution exception at the start of the script are retained unchanged.

license_notice: Original source/build-helper copyright and third-party license notices are retained verbatim. The component summaries do not replace individual file terms.
